For Elasticsearch 1.5, OpenSearch Service supports the following operations.
• All operations in the index path, such
as /index-name /_optimize  and
/index-name /_warmer, except /index-
name /_close
• /_alias
• /_aliases
• /_all

• /_bulk
• /_cat
